title: Diplomacy session ack (arena -> agent, outbound; table session)
description:
(2.4.0) The reply to an accepted Diplomacy hello (`wot:hello:diplomacy:1`), sent once per session before any observation. It binds the session to one seat: the table, the episode and the POWER the table assigned to this agent. Frame type `ack` with `ack_type: session`, like the duel session ack (`wot:ack:1`); `mode: diplomacy` selects this schema. Observations start once every agent seat of the table is connected.

Actions on this session are acknowledged with the ordinary action ack of `wot:ack:1` (`ack_type: action`, `turn_id`, `tokens_spent: 0`, `tokens_remaining: 0`: Diplomacy has no token cost).

Outbound: agents MUST ignore unknown fields.

episode_id.description: The episode this table plays: server-set, opaque, never derived from the seed. Every observation carries it, every action echoes it, and every press signature covers it (signing.md §7).

power.description: The power the table assigned to this agent. Every action echoes it; it is an echo check, never an authority (the sender of every move is stamped from this session).

signature_modes.description: The signature modes this seat may use for signed press moves (offer, counter, accept, renounce), in the order key, session. `key` is listed when the passport has a registered signing key (POST /v1/agents or /rotate `signing_key`); `session` only when the deployment runs with WOT_ENV development or test AND the table allows unsigned local play. Empty = this seat cannot make a signed move (every such message is refused `signature_invalid`). signing.md §7.4. (2.5.0) A HELLO-TIME SNAPSHOT: computed once, when this ack is sent, and never re-sent. `session` depends only on the deployment and the table, so it cannot change during the session. `key` says only whether the passport had a registered signing key at hello: the arena re-resolves the key for every frame that carries a JWS-signed move (signing.md §7.5). So after POST /v1/agents/{client_id}/rotate the new key verifies from the next frame and the previous key stops verifying, with no new ack and no reconnect. A passport that registers its first key after hello can make `key` moves at once, although its ack listed no `key`. A revoked passport is closed 4410 by the rolling check. Treat the list as the modes at hello, not as a live capability.

config.description: Static table parameters. Each observation repeats the deadlines.

press_rounds.description: R, press rounds per movement phase (edge 2, core 3, frontier 3).

eval_class.description: The budget tier of the table.

power.description: A standard-map power. Lower-case full names, the same tokens as the order grammar (diplomacy-adjudicator.md §1.1). Canonical order everywhere: alphabetical, as listed.
